text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is here at last! I'm so focused I can't even look at the other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Except for King, who's radiant as a phoenix. As expected, she's stolen my attention—nay, my heart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: When I think about how I'll be able to look into the depths of King… Drool… ☆ All right! Okay! Let's treat it like any other race!
